_doc: Tuning-set SAMPLE — a CI fixture for the tuning/assessment separation (FR-24, story 4.1), NOT deployment case content. A tuning set is composition-free (it exists to tune against, never to assess) but every case carries provenance: 'tuning'. A case copied into an assessment set is refused BY THAT FIELD, not by its directory.

entries.query: Which chunk text should the reranker keep for a subsidy deadline query?
entries.reference_answer: The chunk carrying the deadline sentence outranks the generic programme description.
